title: Kinolune signed remote configuration
description: Structure of config/remote-config.json (CORE-014, ADR-0039; parser: core/crates/pa-remote-config/src/model.rs, RemoteConfig::validate). JSON Schema does not check the minisign signature (.minisig) or the anti-rollback rule on serial. Clients ignore unknown fields.

schema.description: Format version. Clients reject 0 and any schema above the one they support (SUPPORTED_SCHEMA = 1).

serial.description: Monotonic document number (u64); a client never accepts a smaller serial than it already has.

flags.description: Feature flags; a missing flag is off. Known: twitch.gql_playback, twitch.chapters_gql, twitch.chat_replay, twitch.archive.

feature.description: Flag name, prefix pattern (twitch.*) or *; also twitch.native_player and updates.install, which have no flag.

platforms.description: android, ios, tvos, macos, linux, windows; empty or missing: all.

persisted_queries.description: GQL operation name -> persisted-query sha256 hash.

player.description: native or embed; any other value means embed.

release_public_key.description: minisign public key (base64 line of minisign.pub) that signs SHA256SUMS of app releases (PKG-018, ADR-0088). Not the config key.
